text:
IP300
Integrative Seminar in International Policy
0.5 Credit
Hours per week:
Lecture/Discussion: 3
A hands-on seminar that integrates across the different
disciplines
involved in international policy. Guest speakers and case simulations will bring real-world policy issues to the classroom. An active, collaborative and problem-based approach will prepare students for further study and employment in the field.
Additional Course Information
Co-requisites
Registration status: Year 3 or Year 4 and completion of
EC120
;
EC140
;
GS101
or
HR163
;
PO245
or HR223/DMJN223; and
PO231
or
PO232
or
HR328
, or permission of the School of International Policy and Governance.
